description: Sets an environment variable / secret of the app (e.g. an API key or a database password) and restarts it. The value is stored on the server, never in the code, and is never shown back. Ask the user for the value; do not write it in any file.

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

name: set_env
title: Set an environment variable or secret
